title: 6. Model artifact integrity verification
summary: When downloading a model artifact, verify that its checksum matches a trusted value obtained through an independent trusted channel. A checksum verifies that the file matches the expected bytes. It does not prove that the expected file itself is trustworthy. The expected checksum must come from a trusted source.
